pagerbot: [incident-bot] Page fired — service: realtime-ingest, rule: spike-5xx, severity: P1. PagerDuty incident: https://pd.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-78432

oncall-bot: Auto-page routed to 'ops-nightshift' (schedule bind id: sb-874). Looks like a shift-binding spillover from last night's schedule rotate.

Sam K: Acking. Observed ~18% 5xx across ingest-proxy in us-west-2. Reqs dropping. Checking logs now.

Jen Ops: Confirming — this looks like the alert should have gone to 'infra-ingest' primary oncall. The new schedule change may have left a stale binding. I can rebind if someone with PD admin is ok.

Matt R: I'm available. Do we need to suppress pages to avoid fanout? Recommend ack + set escalation hold.

Sam K: Acked. I'll suppress until we reroute. How to rebind? is there a CLI snippet?

Matt R: Use PD CLI: 
```
pd rules update --id sb-874 --bind-to-service infra-ingest --escalation-policy infra-ingest-ep
pd services list --filter realtime-ingest
``` 
(need PD admin token)

Laura: I've got admin. Doing the rebind now.

pagerbot: Incident INC-78432: ack by Sam K (oncall). Suppressing duplicate pages for 10m.

Laura: Ran:
```
pd rules update --id sb-874 --bind-to-service infra-ingest --escalation-policy infra-ingest-ep --auth-token REDACTED
``` 
Response: success. New binding: infra-ingest. Validating routing.

Tia: Can someone confirm no other schedules are shadow-bound? Run quick grep on schedule exports: 
```
pd schedules export --org redwood | grep -i ingest | sed -n '1,200p'
``` 
I see sb-874 now points to infra-ingest, older bind sb-773 still exists for ops-nightshift in a shadow rule. Suggest we delete sb-773.

Jen Ops: Deleting sb-773 now to prevent spillback.

Laura: Deleted sb-773. Confirmed no immediate fanout. PagerDuty shows oncall now infra-ingest primary.

Sam K: Rolling a small traffic test — simulating 100 requests. Monitoring.

pagerbot: Alert update: error rate dropping to 4% within 120s. Customer-facing impact reduced. Current incidents: INC-78432 (acknowledged, routing corrected).

Matt R: Leaving a manual note: we should add a CI check for schedule diffs before merges to schedule config. Also add an automation to verify bindings during rotation.

Sam K: Agree. Filing follow-up: https://redwood.internal/ops/incidents/INC-78432 (postmortem trigger created)

Jen Ops: Notify support and CS: minimal impact, but some customers in us-west saw 5xx for ~3m. @support-team please flag 2 customers for proactive outreach.

pagerbot: Notifying escalation: message sent to #support (thread started)

Tia: Root cause: schedule migration script left an orphan binding (sb-773) which conflicted with new bind. Action items: (1) add preflight check, (2) add revert playbook, (3) automation test for sb shadowing.

Laura: I'm scheduling a retro with infra and oncall rotation owners tomorrow 10:00 PT.

Sam K: Thanks everyone. Closing thread; will update postmortem once draft is ready. :thumbsup:
